title: Math Cards — eight-book subject inventory
purpose: Reusable planning inventory for expansion of Math Cards. This file does not modify or audit the existing portfolio project.

completeness.reason: Uploaded images show covers or publication pages, not complete contents/indexes. Accessible matching sources were checked; unavailable detail remains provisional.
finalization_needed: Solomon complete original contents and index
Page-level anchors for all authored cards

evidence_statuses.confirmed_scope: Supported by photographed text, matching book contents, original chapter text, or publisher/preview terminology. Does not certify depth or all subordinate claims.
evidence_statuses.provisional_book_mapping: Candidate subject-to-book association requiring an original-page or exact-edition check. Not verified book coverage.
evidence_statuses.proposed_bridge: Editorial relationship or implementation suggestion, not asserted source coverage.

source_policy.page_numbers: Not invented; add exact page anchors when inspecting original books.
source_policy.depth: Keep historical mention, introductory explanation, textbook treatment, and application distinct.
source_policy.historical_status: Recheck the present status of conjectures, scientific claims, and methods before authoring current explanatory cards.
source_policy.rights: Use original explanations and diagrams; owning these books does not grant reuse rights for their scans or illustrations.

books.title: Principles and Procedures of Statistics: A Biometrical Approach
books.verification: Matching edition identity and chapter-level coverage confirmed.

books.title: The Computational Brain
books.edition: Original work 1992; photographed paperback ISBN published 1994
books.role: Mathematics of neural computation and biological models
books.verification: Matching ISBN, original chapter text, original contents, and publisher description checked. Historical research context retained.

books.title: Probability and Statistics for Engineering and the Sciences
books.role: Probability foundations and applied statistical methods
books.verification: Edition identity confirmed. Detailed 1987 contents were not accessible; candidate topic mappings require edition check. Later editions are not treated as proof of 1987 coverage.

books.title: The Language of Mathematics: The Stories behind the Symbols
books.role: Meaning, notation, history, and cultural context
books.verification: Matching ISBN and publisher-distributed detailed contents checked. Coverage is often historical introduction rather than technical mastery.

books.title: The Little Book of Mathematical Principles, Theories & Things
books.role: Chronological discovery survey across mathematical subjects
books.verification: Matching publisher description and same-work Google preview checked. Additional candidate subjects remain explicitly provisional; the advertised 120-plus entries are not represented as fully page-audited.

books.title: Lattice Theory: First Concepts and Distributive Lattices
books.role: Order, algebraic structure, and distributive lattices
books.verification: Photo and matching-ISBN transcribed contents checked. Original contents PDF fetch failed. Detailed mappings remain provisional pending original pages. Do not substitute General Lattice Theory or Lattice Theory: Foundation; eight-appendix wording on the photographed back cover is not reliable evidence of those contents.

books.title: Thermodynamics
books.role: Physical and chemical applications of mathematical models
books.verification: Matching ISBN and detailed contents checked. Original 1923 title is not used as a substitute for the revised edition.

books.title: The Information: A History, a Theory, a Flood
books.role: Information, communication, computation, and intellectual history
books.verification: Photo, matching-work contents, and publisher description checked. Technical subtopics inferred from broad headings remain provisional. Jacket praise for Chaos, Genius, and Isaac Newton does not identify additional photographed books.

proposed_cross_domain_bridges.boundary: Probability models feed information measures; information is not identical to meaning.
Shannon entropy and thermodynamic entropy have different definitions, units, and interpretation; physical assumptions must be stated.
Matrix operations can model network computation; model behavior alone does not establish biological mechanism.
A lattice is a specific ordered structure, not a synonym for every network or hierarchy.
Correlation and model fit do not by themselves establish causation.
Chaotic deterministic behavior must remain distinct from stochastic sampling.
First use, later popularization, and modern standardization may involve different people and dates.

proposed_visual_modules.interaction: Select a symbol to reveal meaning, pronunciation, alternate uses, and a dated source trail.
Drag nodes in an order diagram and inspect meet, join, and counterexamples.
Repeat samples and watch estimates, sampling distributions, and interval coverage change.
Move observations or treatment assignments and inspect residuals and confounding.
Change symbol frequencies and channel noise to compare uncertainty and recoverability.
Change state variables and compare paths, energy balances, and equilibrium.
Adjust connections in a small network and inspect activation and learning.
Compare nearby initial conditions and distinguish numerical error, chaos, and random noise.

implementation_notes: Use stable concept identifiers independent of book chapters.
Preserve distinct senses of overloaded terms such as normal, field, lattice, information, and entropy.
A subject inventory entry is a candidate for cards, not a completed learning object.
Keep prerequisites and editorial bridges separate from claims about what a book contains.
